CustomField.label: Claim Submitted
CustomField.description: Demo lock for the Universal Budget grid: true once the disbursement has left the Scheduled status. Mapped as the Disbursement Submitted Field; the sheet opened from this disbursement renders read-only when it is true. Every subscriber writes its own formula over its own status model.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shown once this claim has been submitted. Its budget sheet is read-only from then on.
